title: Pearls & Oy-sters: Beyond the Bone Marrow-VEXAS Syndrome Presenting as Subacute Encephalomyelitis.
snippet: Vacuoles, E1 enzyme, X-linked, Autoinflammatory, Somatic (VEXAS) syndrome is an adult-onset autoinflammatory disease caused by acquired somatic UBA1 mutations, typically presenting with systemic inflammation and myelodysplastic syndrome.
